overall_summary: Analysis of historical performance shows clear audience preference for domestic relationship dynamics, specifically husband-wife topics (outlier hits of ~1.7k views), while generic poetic/sad shayari underperforms heavily.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos like 'Shaadi Ke Baad Pyaar Kahan Chala Gaya?' (1,770 views) and 'पत्नी की ये बात हर पति को समझनी चाहिए' (1,679 views) significantly outperformed all other content.
winning_patterns.action: Double down on marital relationships, emotional misunderstandings, and long-term love realities.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos covering parental love and family roles (e.g., 'माँ जब पूछती है', 'पापा कभी कहते नहीं') perform steadily in the 150-300 view range.
winning_patterns.action: Keep family emotional beats as reliable secondary content.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'जिस दिन सच लिखूंगा… रिश्तों को षड्यंत्र लिखूंगा' generated only 21 views.
weak_patterns.action: Avoid abstract, overly dramatic poetry and focus on concrete everyday situations.
